comment: Eligibility rules for the student-facing «Сильные стороны» cards (PRO-432). Loaded by app.config.load_student_strengths_rules. Changing a rule = edit here + bump `version`, NO code change (same contract as the other *_thresholds.json files). These are transparent product rules on top of each instrument's own bands, not norms. max_cards/max_per_domain: at most 6 cards, at most 2 per meaning domain (a first pass takes the best card of each domain, so different domains win over a second card of the same one). astur_*: a task group (e.g. numeric series) becomes a card only when the attempt's protocol_quality is ok, the group's accuracy is at least astur_min_percent, and it is among the student's astur_max_cards best groups; the timed commands need astur_quick_min_percent on-time accuracy. ddo_*: interest (0..max picks of a scale) and self-rated ability (0-3) are normalized separately and never compared raw; «Хочу + Могу» needs interest share >= ddo_interest_min_share AND ability >= ddo_ability_min; «Могу > Хочу» needs ability >= ddo_ability_only_min with interest share < ddo_ability_only_interest_max_share. belbin_*: the leading role(s) must score >= belbin_min_score (8 roles share 70 points, 8.75 on average) and stay out of the avoidance zone; roles within belbin_tie_margin of the top are merged into one card (never a key-order winner), three or more such roles = no clear signal, no card. empathy_*: Boyko total in one of empathy_levels, a named channel needs >= empathy_channel_min of its 6 items. suppress_self_report_on_lie_flag: an Eysenck lie-scale-flagged protocol keeps only task results and interests — self-reports can't be read as confident strengths then.
